findings.summary: Two accepted requirements still describe the removed continuity mechanism and are not modified by the delta. "Public rollout core contains no private-project compatibility branches" has an external operator-owned compatibility mechanism scenario. "Removing private compatibility does not silently break the operator fleet" has a scenario about recording operator-owned compatibility configuration. The latter's "records the required operator-owned compatibility configuration" clause now has no mechanism behind it, since the delta removes the operator config section.

The delta expresses the rename and narrowing of the conformance requirement as ADDED plus REMOVED rather than RENAMED or MODIFIED. The REMOVED block names the old header, and the new header is added, so archive should work. The removed scenario "Project-owned publication harness has unexpected drift" is reworded rather than preserved, and the `harness_mode=project` conformance gate now relies on the new wording. Archive materialization should be checked for this.
